OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: The scope of the connector, i.e. the entity types it imports.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: Time to wait between two runs of the connector, as an ISO 8601 duration (e.g. `PT6H` for six hours). The feed is dated by day, so a shorter period does not bring more data.

OFFENSIVE_AGENCY_API_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the offensive.agency API. The connector reads the STIX feed at `<api_base_url>/feeds/stix.json`.

OFFENSIVE_AGENCY_TLP_LEVEL.description: TLP marking applied to every object the connector creates. The feed is public and carries no marking.

OFFENSIVE_AGENCY_INDICATOR_VALIDITY.description: How long an indicator stays valid after the feed last saw the agent on its IP, as an ISO 8601 duration (e.g. `P30D` for 30 days). The feed only keeps the last 7 days: an IP that leaves it expires in OpenCTI once this period has passed. Minimum `P1D`, since the feed is dated by day.

OFFENSIVE_AGENCY_CREATE_OBSERVABLES.description: Create an IPv4 observable for each indicator, linked by a `based-on` relationship.
